answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond before it can vote or claim rewards, with the bond forfeited if the same identity is caught voting twice or endorsing a duplicate. Like a pearl formed only under sustained pressure, credibility should accumulate slowly through verifiable work, not appear instantly. A single ember of bad behavior burns the bond, while honest nectar, small repeated checkable contributions, rebuilds trust over time, making a thousand fake identities far costlier than one real one.
